g.text: Host pauses preserve overlap/history; a completed core can still leave output bytes for the host to drain.

g.text: The HPS interleaves PCM writes with Y and spectral reads. Chunk boundaries do not reset the core or start new

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a66882

g.text: Production completion is not host reception
DONE can leave FIFO data unread. The host continues draining and verifies

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8066a9

g.text: CLEAR preserves the epoch counter; hardware reset resets it. These are logical
token phases, not measured wall-clock intervals.
